title: PersonaMix Solo #27 (솔로 · 청동=아마조네스 · 청동 금빛 · 앵글 기본(허리 높이) · 체형 super hourglass · 인종 Latina · 메이크업 비주얼계 블랙립 5단계 · 극한 · 배경 겨울 눈 광장 · 힐 40인치 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, mid 30s, an Amazon warrior queen of ancient legend, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, half-up half-down auburn hair — full body polished golden bronze fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid cast bronze curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted bronze sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING bright polished golden bronze across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID darker amber tarnish gathering in every recess and joint, with carved relief of waves across the surface of every section, mirror-polished raised edges, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: hands on her hips in a powerful stance, chin lifted, weight on one leg — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of the same bronze, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, made of the same bronze with a high polish.
Jewelry: a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT bronze — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: heavily smudged black eyeshadow blazing from the lash line up to the temples, thick smeared black liner all around the eyes, clumped black lashes top and bottom, fully opaque saturated jet-black lips, deeply shadowed black contour under the cheekbones.

Background: a snow-covered stone plaza in soft daylight with light snow lying only on the ground, a fountain edge under snow, standard lamp posts and a waist-high railing, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
